evidence.reason: The finding asks that legacyFingerprintFailure restore the scheme-1 title-chain message (titles joined with ' > ') instead of hashing the new JSON-array message, while leaving the canonical fingerprint unchanged. The current region already implements this: legacyFingerprintFailure (line 125-130) now computes `const message = resolved.tool === 'vitest' ? legacyVitestMessage(f.message) : f.message;` and passes it into locationComponents, and the helper legacyVitestMessage (lines 132-151) parses a JSON string array and returns `parts.filter(part => part !== '').join(' > ')`, returning anything non-array unchanged. Canonical fingerprintKey/fingerprintFailure are untouched. The prior formatter's join(' > ') behavior is restored exactly, so persisted scheme-1 signatures match again. History attributes the region to commit 5ebe7415c22f924b5f6b8a87b361bfaccad2cff2 ("fix(gates): Resolve crq triage findings in fingerprint, hackDetector, policyDiff, workflowScan").
